ನೀವು (neevu) is respectful “you”. ನೀನು (neenu) is for close friends and kids. Use neevu with everyone else.
Indiranagara + ge = Indiranagarakke (to Indiranagar). Majestic-ge, Koramangala-ge: this one suffix unlocks most directions.
Kodi means “give”, and adding -i makes it polite. “Neeru kodi” = water, please. It works for anything you want.
Kannada says “I water want”, not “I want water”. Put the doing word at the end and you sound natural.
Call a man older than you “anna” and a woman “akka”. Vendors, drivers and neighbours love it.
ಸರಿ (sari) = okay/right. ಇಲ್ಲ (illa) = no/not. Two words that carry half of daily talk.
